# Example designs

Generated from the engine's own catalogs, the same text Card Studio's describe-a-finish reads. Field lines read `` `key` (type or range): what it does ``; "— leave out" marks fields a design written from a description shouldn't set (uploads, licensed assets, internal state). A host that has its own images may still set them (`decals`, `surfaceSources`, `logo.src`). Section names in quotes ("Lighting", "Fonts") refer to headings in these references.

## Examples

"Champagne gold with a fine brushed grain and a faint silvery holo":
```json
{
  "recipe": {
    "material": "silver",
    "color": "#d8bd86",
    "texture": "brushed",
    "grain": 34,
    "polish": 72,
    "relief": 30,
    "spectrum": 8,
    "frontHolo": true,
    "matchHoloSides": true,
    "holoStyle": "shiny",
    "foilTexture": "etched",
    "foilIntensity": 26,
    "holoGlare": 30
  },
  "cardholderName": "Ada Lovelace",
  "cardholderBio": "",
  "decals": [],
  "surfaceSources": {},
  "surfaceTreatments": {}
}
```

"Gunmetal with a slow oil-slick sheen (a built-in shader layer)":
```json
{
  "recipe": {
    "material": "titanium",
    "color": "#3d3e3c",
    "texture": "none",
    "grain": 0,
    "polish": 64,
    "relief": 0,
    "spectrum": 12
  },
  "cardholderName": "Ada Lovelace",
  "cardholderBio": "",
  "decals": [],
  "surfaceSources": {},
  "surfaceTreatments": {},
  "shaders": [
    {
      "id": "oil-slick",
      "side": "both",
      "target": "overlay",
      "blend": "screen",
      "params": {
        "strength": 0.3,
        "speed": 0.15
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

"Coarse brushed steel whose streaks read on the whole card (a custom WGSL skin under the metal)":
```json
{
  "recipe": {
    "material": "silver",
    "color": "#b9bcc0",
    "texture": "brushed",
    "grain": 60,
    "polish": 66,
    "relief": 70,
    "spectrum": 0
  },
  "cardholderName": "Ada Lovelace",
  "cardholderBio": "",
  "decals": [],
  "surfaceSources": {},
  "surfaceTreatments": {},
  "shaders": [
    {
      "id": "custom",
      "language": "wgsl",
      "side": "both",
      "target": "skin",
      "params": {
        "uContrast": 0.12,
        "uLines": 440
      },
      "code": "// Brushed streaks that read at card size: hairlines of the base colour, long along x.\nvar<private> uContrast: f32; // @param 0 0.4 0.12 label=\"Streak contrast\"\nvar<private> uLines: f32;    // @param 60 600 440 label=\"Hairlines per card height\"\n\nfn mainImage(uv: vec2f) -> vec4f {\n  let p = facePos;\n  let n = 0.6 * noise(vec2f(p.x * 9.0, p.y * uLines)) + 0.4 * noise(vec2f(p.x * 1.7 + 9.0, p.y * uLines * 0.41));\n  return vec4f(uBaseColor * (1.0 + (n - 0.5) * 2.0 * uContrast), 1.0);\n}"
    }
  ]
}
```

"Midnight-blue metal with gold contour lines (a custom WGSL skin)":
```json
{
  "recipe": {
    "material": "silver",
    "color": "#1b2340",
    "texture": "none",
    "grain": 0,
    "polish": 66,
    "relief": 0,
    "spectrum": 0
  },
  "cardholderName": "Ada Lovelace",
  "cardholderBio": "",
  "decals": [],
  "surfaceSources": {},
  "surfaceTreatments": {},
  "shaders": [
    {
      "id": "custom",
      "language": "wgsl",
      "side": "front",
      "target": "skin",
      "code": "// Gold topographic contour lines over the base colour, calm around the chip.\nvar<private> uLine: vec3f;  // @color #d9b25f label=\"Line colour\"\nvar<private> uScale: f32;   // @param 1 10 3.5 label=\"Scale\"\nvar<private> uLines: f32;   // @param 4 40 14 label=\"Lines\"\n\nfn mainImage(uv: vec2f) -> vec4f {\n  let h = fbm(facePos * uScale);\n  let f = fract(h * uLines);\n  let w = fwidth(h * uLines);\n  var line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.5 * w, min(f, 1.0 - f));\n  line *= smoothstep(0.0, 0.05, chipDistance(uv));\n  return vec4f(mix(uBaseColor, uLine, line), 1.0);\n}"
    }
  ]
}
```
